name: Linguistics (PMn)

rules.name: Remaining units in Linguistics (100 level or above)
rules.desc: Students must complete 30 units of coursework in Linguistics. At least 20 units must be graduate courses at the 200 level or above; 10 units may be at the 100 level or above, but they may not be below the 100 level.

rules.name: Introductory Courses
rules.desc: The coursework for the minor must include one introductory course in each of phonetics/phonology, syntax, and semantics/pragmatics; these requirements are typically fulfilled by the following:

rules.name: Research Project (Optional)
rules.desc: The student may elect to present a paper that integrates the subject matter of linguistics into the student’s field of specialization.

rules.name: Program of courses worked out in advance with your Linguistics minor advisor

gpa: The overall coursework grade point average (GPA) must be at least 3.0 (B).
grading: Most of the courses taken toward the 30 units of coursework must be taken for a letter grade. These should include the three required introductory courses, all completed with at least a B and taken for four units.
policies:
• Courses submitted for the minor may not be double-counted in satisfaction of degree requirements for the student’s doctoral or any other program. Individual programs should be worked out in advance with the student’s PhD minor advisor in Linguistics.

• The Department of Linguistics does not require the student’s Linguistics advisor to serve on the student’s University Oral Examination committee.
transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks 30 units of Linguistics (LINGUIST) courses: one introductory course each in phonetics/phonology, syntax and semantics/pragmatics, each letter graded, B or better, and taken for 4 units, with at least 20 of the 30 units in graduate courses numbered 200 or above and none below 100. Work out the rest of your courses in advance with your Linguistics minor advisor. Checked by hand: that program, the 3.0 overall GPA, that most of the 30 units are letter graded, and that no course also counts toward your PhD or another program. The research paper is optional.

totals.label: 20 units of graduate Linguistics courses at the 200 level or above
